description.summary: Small-to-Big retrieval: search small per-visit chunks, but answer from the full patient document.
description.how_it_works: During indexing we build a small chunk per visit and a large parent document per patient (plus one per doctor and department), and embed only the small chunks — the parents are stored separately and never embedded. When a question comes in, we find the best matching child chunk and swap it for its full parent so the chat model answers from complete context; this fixes the old problem of a patient's visits being scattered across chunks that lost the patient's identity. The Advanced pipeline first rewrites the query and reranks the child chunks before this swap. Embedded with OpenAI's text-embedding-3-small and text-embedding-3-large.
